blocks.en:
Solve the one-dimensional heat equation via separation of variables for the following boundary conditions:\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $\begin{aligned}u(x,0)&=x^2-x,\\u_x(0,t)&=0,\\u_x(1,t)&=0.\end{aligned}$
\item $\begin{aligned}u(x,0)&=\sin\pi x,\\u(0,t)&=0,\\u_x(1,t)&=0.\end{aligned}$
\item $\begin{aligned}
u(x,0)&=\begin{cases}x,&x\in[0,1/2)\\1-x,&x\in[1/2,1],\end{cases}\\
u(0,t)&=0,\\u(1,t)&=0.
\end{aligned}$
\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh:
用分离变量法求解满足下列边界条件的一维热方程:\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $\begin{aligned}u(x,0)&=x^2-x,\\u_x(0,t)&=0,\\u_x(1,t)&=0.\end{aligned}$
\item $\begin{aligned}u(x,0)&=\sin\pi x,\\u(0,t)&=0,\\u_x(1,t)&=0.\end{aligned}$
\item $\begin{aligned}
u(x,0)&=\begin{cases}x,&x\in[0,1/2)\\1-x,&x\in[1/2,1],\end{cases}\\
u(0,t)&=0,\\u(1,t)&=0.
\end{aligned}$
\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: ex:heat-three-boundary-problems

blocks.en:
In a typical physical problem in heat conduction, one studies the differential equation
\[
c\rho u_t=\kappa\Delta u
\]
where $c$ is the \emph{specific heat}, $\rho$ is the \emph{density}, and $\kappa$ is the thermal conductivity of the medium under consideration. If $c$, $\rho$, and $\kappa$ are constants, show that there is a linear change in time scale $\bar t=\gamma t$ that transforms the differential equation above into \eqref{eq:heat-general}.
blocks.zh:
在典型的热传导物理问题中, 人们研究微分方程
\[
c\rho u_t=\kappa\Delta u
\]
其中 $c$ 是所考察介质的\emph{比热}, $\rho$ 是\emph{密度}, $\kappa$ 是热导率. 如果 $c$, $\rho$ 和 $\kappa$ 都是常数, 证明存在线性的时间尺度变换 $\bar t=\gamma t$, 将上述微分方程化为 \eqref{eq:heat-general}.
blocks.label: ex:heat-physical-time-scaling

blocks.en:
Suppose $f:\overline{D^+}\to\mathbb{R}$ is continuous and $u:\overline{D^+}\to\mathbb{R}$ is a solution of the following nonhomogeneous initial/boundary-value problem:
\[
\begin{gathered}
u_t(x,t)-u_{xx}(x,t)=f(x,t),\quad(x,t)\in D^+,\\
u(x,0)=0,\quad x\in[0,1],\\
u(0,t)=u(1,t)=0,\quad t\in[0,\infty).
\end{gathered}
\]
Now, for each $\tau\in[0,\infty)$, let $w(x,t,\tau)$ be the solution of the following \emph{pulse problem}:
\[
\begin{gathered}
w_t-w_{xx}=0,\quad(x,t)\in(0,1)\times(\tau,\infty),\\
w(x,\tau,\tau)=f(x,\tau),\quad x\in[0,1],\\
w(0,t,\tau)=w(1,t,\tau)=0,\quad t\in[\tau,\infty).
\end{gathered}
\]
Show that $u$ and $w$ satisfy the relation
\[
u(x,t)=\int_0^tw(x,t,\tau)\,\mathrm{d}\tau.
\]
This and similar methods of relating nonhomogeneous PDEs with homogeneous initial conditions to homogeneous PDEs with nonhomogeneous initial conditions are known as Duhamel's principle.
blocks.zh:
设 $f:\overline{D^+}\to\mathbb{R}$ 连续, 且 $u:\overline{D^+}\to\mathbb{R}$ 是如下非齐次初边值问题的一个解:
\[
\begin{gathered}
u_t(x,t)-u_{xx}(x,t)=f(x,t),\quad(x,t)\in D^+,\\
u(x,0)=0,\quad x\in[0,1],\\
u(0,t)=u(1,t)=0,\quad t\in[0,\infty).
\end{gathered}
\]
现在, 对每个 $\tau\in[0,\infty)$, 令 $w(x,t,\tau)$ 为如下\emph{脉冲问题}的解:
\[
\begin{gathered}
w_t-w_{xx}=0,\quad(x,t)\in(0,1)\times(\tau,\infty),\\
w(x,\tau,\tau)=f(x,\tau),\quad x\in[0,1],\\
w(0,t,\tau)=w(1,t,\tau)=0,\quad t\in[\tau,\infty).
\end{gathered}
\]
证明 $u$ 和 $w$ 满足关系
\[
u(x,t)=\int_0^tw(x,t,\tau)\,\mathrm{d}\tau.
\]
这种方法以及类似的将具有齐次初始条件的非齐次偏微分方程与具有非齐次初始条件的齐次偏微分方程相联系的方法, 称为 Duhamel 原理.
blocks.label: ex:duhamel-heat-pulse

blocks.en:
Solve the Cauchy problem
\[
u_t=u_{xx},\qquad u(x,0)=\begin{cases}0,&x<0\\1,&x>0.\end{cases}
\]
Hint: Seek a solution in the form $u(x,t)=\phi(x/\sqrt t)$.
blocks.zh:
求解 Cauchy 问题
\[
u_t=u_{xx},\qquad u(x,0)=\begin{cases}0,&x<0\\1,&x>0.\end{cases}
\]
Hint: 寻找形如 $u(x,t)=\phi(x/\sqrt t)$ 的解.
